presentationColumns.name: Transaction ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Transaction ID
presentationColumns.description: Sales transaction identifier from the base sales fact. Use it for transaction-level detail or distinct transaction counts; it is not intended as an aggregate KPI.

presentationColumns.name: Date Key

presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: Collection ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Collection ID
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: Channel ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Channel ID
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: Promotion ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Promotion ID
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: Units Sold
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Units Sold
presentationColumns.description: Primary sales quantity from the base sales fact. Use this as the enterprise sales volume KPI when analyzing sales by date, product, store, customer, channel, promotion, or collection.

presentationColumns.name: Gross Sales Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Gross Sales Amount
presentationColumns.description: Sales value before discounts, markdowns, returns, or cost deductions.

presentationColumns.name: Discount Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Discount Amount
presentationColumns.description: Total discount or markdown value applied to sales lines.

presentationColumns.name: Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.description: Primary sales value after discounts and markdowns. Use this for revenue analysis across the standard business dimensions; it is the cleanest value for dashboard sales trends and comparisons.

presentationColumns.name: Cost Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Cost Amount
presentationColumns.description: Total standard product cost associated with the sold units.

presentationColumns.name: Gross Margin Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Gross Margin Amount
presentationColumns.description: Net sales minus product cost. Use this to compare profitability across products, stores, channels, and collections.

presentationColumns.name: Markdown Pct Raw
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Markdown Pct Raw
presentationColumns.description: Raw line-level markdown ratio used as an input to markdown calculations.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Line Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Full Price Line Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of sales lines sold without markdown.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Full Price Units
presentationColumns.description: Units sold without markdown. Use this to understand demand quality and whether volume is coming from full-price selling rather than discounting.

presentationColumns.name: Returned Line Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Returned Line Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of sales lines that later generated a return.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Sales Line Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Sales Line Count
presentationColumns.description: Count of sales lines, useful as a transaction-detail activity measure.

presentationColumns.name: Transaction Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Transaction Count
presentationColumns.description: Distinct sales transactions represented in the selected context.

presentationColumns.name: Average Selling Price
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Average Selling Price
presentationColumns.description: Net sales amount divided by units sold; a proxy for realized price.

presentationColumns.name: Gross Margin Pct
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Gross Margin Pct
presentationColumns.description: Gross margin fraction after applying the current filters. Calculated as gross margin amount divided by net sales amount; format as a percentage in OAC.

presentationColumns.name: Markdown Pct
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Markdown Pct
presentationColumns.description: Markdown fraction after applying the current filters. Calculated as discount amount divided by gross sales amount; format as a percentage in OAC.

presentationColumns.name: Return Line Rate
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Return Line Rate
presentationColumns.description: Fraction of sales lines flagged as returned after applying the current filters. Format as a percentage in OAC.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Line Share
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Full Price Line Share
presentationColumns.description: Fraction of sales lines sold at full price after applying the current filters. Format as a percentage in OAC.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Unit Share Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Sales KPIs.Full Price Unit Share Percent
presentationColumns.description: Full-price units as a percentage of total units sold.

presentationTable.description: Base warehouse sales measures from FASHIONDW.FACT_SALES. Use this as the canonical folder for observed sales, revenue, margin, markdown, and full-price selling.
